# Cherry Builds

> VBA Licensed renovation builder in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.

Cherry Builds delivers expert home renovations across Melbourne's Bayside and Mornington Peninsula. VBA Licensed (DB-71349), 30+ years experience. Fixed prices, free quotes.

## Services

- [Full Home Renovations](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/full-home-renovations): Complete home transformations from structural changes through to finishes.
- [Bathroom Renovations](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/bathroom-renovations): Full bathroom renovations including waterproofing, tiling, fixtures, and fit-off.
- [Kitchen Renovations](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/kitchen-renovations): Custom kitchen design and installation, cabinetry, benchtops, splashbacks, and appliances.
- [Decking & Landscaping](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/decking-landscaping): Timber and composite decking, outdoor living, and landscaping.
- [Tiling & Flooring](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/tiling-flooring): All tile and flooring formats for wet and dry areas, floor and wall.
- [Waterproofing](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/waterproofing): AS3740-compliant waterproofing for bathrooms, balconies, and wet areas.
- [Plastering & Painting](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/plastering-painting): Internal and external plastering and painting.
- [Property Preparation](https://cherrybuilds.com.au/services/property-preparation): Pre-sale and pre-lease property preparation and make-good works.
